Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [All Turns] effect trigger when either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon suspends?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can suspend either player's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to suspend either my Digimon or my opponent's Digimon?

Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any Digimon suspend, this Digimon may unsuspend.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, for every 2 suspended Digimon, you may return 1 of your opponent's suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.
Special Digivolution Condition: [Digivolve] Play cost 10 or higher Lv.6 w/[Vortex Warriors] trait: Cost 1
